The Flash Trigger ORB
Roboquant
Strategy
Official
Use this template


154 downloads
42 favorites
Added Sep 15, 2026, 10:03 AM
A single targeted candle - selected by timeframe and a local hour and minute in a user-adjustable UTC offset - defines the range: its high is drawn as a green line and its low as a red line, extending a few bars to the right and kept on the chart so previous sessions' ranges stay visible. Once that candle closes the range is confirmed, and the entries are close-based: a candle closing above the range high goes long with the stop at the range low, a close below the range low goes short with the stop at the range high, and the target is a configurable Risk:Reward multiple of that stop distance. Only one trade is allowed per confirmed range. Position size is a fixed lot, a fixed dollar risk per trade, or a percentage of account equity risked at the stop; an optional trailing stop tightens the exit once the trade is a set number of points in profit, trailing at a fixed buffer distance. An optional weekday filter skips the range on disabled days, and an end-of-day flatten closes any open position at a configurable UTC time. This showcase run uses the MNQ 15m preset: a 14:30 UTC targeted candle, 3:1 Risk:Reward, 1% of account risked per trade, trailing on (70 points to activate, 25-point buffer), and a 23:59 UTC flatten.

use rq_sdk::prelude::*;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// The Flash Trigger ORB
//
// Marks the high/low of a single targeted candle (chosen by timeframe +
// hour + minute, in a user-adjustable UTC offset). Once that candle
// closes, the range is "confirmed" and drawn as a green (high) and red
// (low) horizontal line extending 5 bars to the right. Previous days'
// range lines are kept on the chart (never deleted).
//
// Trade logic:
//   - Close above confirmed range high  -> go LONG.  SL = range low.
//   - Close below confirmed range low   -> go SHORT. SL = range high.
//   - TP = entry +/- (risk_reward * stop_distance)
//   - Only one trade is allowed per confirmed range (per day).
//   - Optional trailing SL: once price is trail_activate_points in profit,
//     the stop trails price at a fixed trail_buffer_points distance.
//   - Optional day filter: when enabled, the targeted candle is only
//     evaluated (and no range/trade is taken) on the enabled weekdays,
//     based on the local (UTC + offset) calendar date.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const LINE_EXTEND_BARS: i64 = 5;

#[strategy(name = "The Flash Trigger ORB")]
pub struct FlashTriggerOrb {
    #[param(default = 15, options = [1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 30, 45, 60, 120, 180, 240], title = "Targeted Candle Timeframe (min)")]
    candle_tf_min: i64,

    #[param(default = 14, min = 0, max = 23, title = "Targeted Candle Hour")]
    target_hour: i64,

    #[param(default = 30, min = 0, max = 59, title = "Targeted Candle Minute")]
    target_minute: i64,

    #[param(default = 0, min = -12, max = 14, title = "UTC Offset (hours)")]
    utc_offset: i64,

    #[param(default = 3.0, min = 0.1, max = 20.0, title = "Risk:Reward")]
    risk_reward: f64,

    // 0 = Fixed Lot Size, 1 = Fixed $ Risk per Trade, 2 = % of Account Risk per Trade
    #[param(default = 0, options = [0, 1, 2], title = "Risk Per Trade Mode (0=Fixed Lot, 1=Fixed $, 2=% Account)")]
    risk_mode: i64,

    #[param(default = 1.0, min = 1.0, max = 1000.0, title = "Fixed Lot Size")]
    lot_size: f64,

    #[param(default = 100.0, min = 1.0, max = 1000000.0, title = "Risk Per Trade ($)")]
    risk_usd: f64,

    #[param(default = 1.0, min = 0.01, max = 100.0, title = "Risk Per Trade (% of Account)")]
    risk_percent: f64,

    #[param(default = 23, min = 0, max = 23, title = "Close All Trades Hour (UTC)")]
    eod_close_hour: i64,

    #[param(default = 59, min = 0, max = 59, title = "Close All Trades Minute (UTC)")]
    eod_close_minute: i64,

    #[param(default = false, title = "Activate Trailing SL")]
    activate_trailing: bool,

    #[param(default = 50.0, min = 0.1, max = 10000.0, title = "Trail Trigger (points in profit)")]
    trail_activate_points: f64,

    #[param(default = 20.0, min = 0.1, max = 10000.0, title = "Trailing Buffer (points)")]
    trail_buffer_points: f64,

    #[param(default = false, title = "Day Filter")]
    day_filter: bool,

    #[param(default = true, title = "Trade Monday")]
    trade_monday: bool,

    #[param(default = true, title = "Trade Tuesday")]
    trade_tuesday: bool,

    #[param(default = true, title = "Trade Wednesday")]
    trade_wednesday: bool,

    #[param(default = true, title = "Trade Thursday")]
    trade_thursday: bool,

    #[param(default = true, title = "Trade Friday")]
    trade_friday: bool,

    // ---- per-session state ----
    session_date: u32,       // local (offset-adjusted) date of the current session
    range_high: f64,
    range_low: f64,
    range_active: bool,      // true once the targeted candle has closed and range is confirmed
    range_start_bar: i64,    // bar index the targeted candle closed on
    traded_this_range: bool, // only one trade per confirmed range

    high_line: Option<DrawingId>,
    low_line: Option<DrawingId>,
    line_freeze_bar: i64,   // bar index at which to freeze the range lines
    lines_frozen: bool,
    utc_session_date: u32,  // raw UTC date, tracked separately from offset-adjusted session_date
    closed_for_day: bool,   // true once EOD flatten has fired for this UTC day
}

impl FlashTriggerOrb {
    /// Shifted local time (UTC + offset) as (date_num, hhmm) using a fixed
    /// hour offset. We build it from the bar's raw UTC micros so DST of the
    /// exchange is irrelevant -- the user explicitly controls the offset.
    fn local_time(&self, bar: &Bar) -> (u32, u32) {
        let offset_us: i64 = self.utc_offset * 3_600_000_000;
        let shifted = Time::from_us(bar.time.us() + offset_us);
        (shifted.date_num(), shifted.hhmm())
    }

    /// Is the given bar's local (offset-adjusted) weekday enabled for
    /// trading? Weekends (Sat/Sun) are always skipped since there is no
    /// corresponding day toggle for them.
    fn day_allowed(&self, bar: &Bar) -> bool {
        if !self.day_filter {
            return true;
        }
        let offset_us: i64 = self.utc_offset * 3_600_000_000;
        let shifted = Time::from_us(bar.time.us() + offset_us);
        match format!("{:?}", shifted.weekday()).as_str() {
            "Monday" => self.trade_monday,
            "Tuesday" => self.trade_tuesday,
            "Wednesday" => self.trade_wednesday,
            "Thursday" => self.trade_thursday,
            "Friday" => self.trade_friday,
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    /// Position size for the configured risk mode. `stop_distance` is the
    /// (positive) price distance between entry and SL.
    fn size_for_trade(&self, ctx: &Ctx, stop_distance: f64) -> i64 {
        match self.risk_mode {
            1 => {
                // Fixed $ risk per trade -- must include contract multiplier
                // and never submit a zero-size order.
                let loss_per_contract = stop_distance.abs() * ctx.contract().multiplier;
                if loss_per_contract > 0.0 {
                    (self.risk_usd / loss_per_contract).floor().max(0.0) as i64
                } else {
                    0
                }
            }
            2 => {
                // % of account equity risked per trade.
                ctx.size_risk_pct(self.risk_percent / 100.0, stop_distance)
            }
            _ => {
                // Fixed lot size.
                self.lot_size.max(1.0) as i64
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Strategy for FlashTriggerOrb {
    fn on_init(&mut self, _init: &mut Init) {}

    fn on_bar(&mut self, ctx: &mut Ctx, bar: Bar) {
        let (local_date, local_hhmm) = self.local_time(&bar);

        // New local day -> reset per-session state (but keep old drawings).
        if local_date != self.session_date {
            self.session_date = local_date;
            self.range_active = false;
            self.traded_this_range = false;
            self.high_line = None;
            self.low_line = None;
            self.lines_frozen = false;
        }

        // New UTC day -> reset the EOD-flatten-fired flag. Tracked on its
        // own UTC date since it is independent of the offset-adjusted
        // session used for the targeted candle / range logic above.
        let utc_date = bar.time.date_num();
        if utc_date != self.utc_session_date {
            self.utc_session_date = utc_date;
            self.closed_for_day = false;
        }

        // End-of-day flatten (UTC, independent of the targeted-candle UTC
        // offset): once per UTC calendar day, at/after the configured UTC
        // close time, close any open position. If nothing is open it does
        // nothing. Does NOT block new entries afterwards.
        let utc_hhmm = bar.time.hhmm();
        let eod_hhmm: u32 = (self.eod_close_hour as u32) * 100 + (self.eod_close_minute as u32);
        if !self.closed_for_day && utc_hhmm >= eod_hhmm {
            if ctx.position() != 0 {
                ctx.close_position();
                ctx.log("Flash Trigger ORB: EOD flatten (UTC)");
            }
            self.closed_for_day = true;
        }

        // Target hh:mm to match, cast once.
        let target_hhmm: u32 = (self.target_hour as u32) * 100 + (self.target_minute as u32);

        // Detect the targeted candle by matching local time-of-day.
        // (The strategy should be run on a timeframe equal to
        // candle_tf_min for the "candle" concept to line up 1:1.)
        if !self.range_active && local_hhmm == target_hhmm && self.day_allowed(&bar) {
            self.range_high = bar.high;
            self.range_low = bar.low;
            self.range_active = true;
            self.traded_this_range = false;
            self.range_start_bar = ctx.bar_index() as i64;
            self.line_freeze_bar = self.range_start_bar + LINE_EXTEND_BARS;
            self.lines_frozen = false;

            let now = ctx.time();

            self.high_line = Some(
                ctx.plot_level(self.range_high)
                    .starting_at(now)
                    .color("#00C853")
                    .label("ORB High")
                    .send(),
            );
            self.low_line = Some(
                ctx.plot_level(self.range_low)
                    .starting_at(now)
                    .color("#FF3B30")
                    .label("ORB Low")
                    .send(),
            );

            ctx.log("Flash Trigger ORB: range confirmed");
            return;
        }

        // Freeze the range lines once they have extended LINE_EXTEND_BARS
        // bars to the right of the confirmed range (keep, don't delete).
        if self.range_active && !self.lines_frozen && (ctx.bar_index() as i64) >= self.line_freeze_bar {
            if let Some(id) = self.high_line { ctx.freeze(id); }
            if let Some(id) = self.low_line { ctx.freeze(id); }
            self.lines_frozen = true;
        }

        // No confirmed range yet, or already traded this range -> nothing to do.
        if !self.range_active || self.traded_this_range {
            return;
        }

        // Don't trade on the same bar the range was formed.
        if (ctx.bar_index() as i64) <= self.range_start_bar {
            return;
        }

        if ctx.position() != 0 {
            return;
        }

        if bar.close > self.range_high {
            let sl = self.range_low;
            let stop_distance = bar.close - sl;
            if stop_distance > 0.0 {
                let qty = self.size_for_trade(ctx, stop_distance);
                if qty > 0 {
                    let tp = bar.close + stop_distance * self.risk_reward;
                    let mut order = ctx.buy(qty).sl(sl).tp(tp);
                    if self.activate_trailing {
                        order = order.trailing(
                            Trail::offset(self.trail_buffer_points)
                                .activate_after(self.trail_activate_points),
                        );
                    }
                    order.send();
                    self.traded_this_range = true;
                    ctx.log("Flash Trigger ORB: LONG entry above range high");
                } else {
                    ctx.log("Flash Trigger ORB: skipped LONG, computed size was 0 (risk too small for stop distance)");
                }
            }
        } else if bar.close < self.range_low {
            let sl = self.range_high;
            let stop_distance = sl - bar.close;
            if stop_distance > 0.0 {
                let qty = self.size_for_trade(ctx, stop_distance);
                if qty > 0 {
                    let tp = bar.close - stop_distance * self.risk_reward;
                    let mut order = ctx.sell(qty).sl(sl).tp(tp);
                    if self.activate_trailing {
                        order = order.trailing(
                            Trail::offset(self.trail_buffer_points)
                                .activate_after(self.trail_activate_points),
                        );
                    }
                    order.send();
                    self.traded_this_range = true;
                    ctx.log("Flash Trigger ORB: SHORT entry below range low");
                } else {
                    ctx.log("Flash Trigger ORB: skipped SHORT, computed size was 0 (risk too small for stop distance)");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
